reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in the thread in #central-team. I confirmed the two details he gave: the Greywater rollout at Marrow Fieldworks has a 9 October deadline, and the Juniper rollout at Tansley Parcel is 131 seats. As he asked, I didn't do anything else.

His message is already saved in gbrain. I searched it and the channel history it holds, and found no other record of either detail to check them against. The search ran on keywords only, so a match worded differently could have been missed.

One thing I didn't mention to him: today is 19 October, so that 9 October deadline has already passed. It may be a typo or an old date.
